The {{AN|Enderman Bulwark}} piece bonus grants {{Stat|def}} against {{MobSprite|Enderman;Endermen}}, which increases with {{MobSprite|Enderman}} kills and caps at {{Stat|def|+400}} per piece, or {{Stat|def|+1600}} in total. This bonus includes {{MobSprite|Zealot}}s, {{MobSprite|Zealot Bruiser}}s, {{MobSprite|Voidling Fanatic}}s, and {{MobSprite|Voidling Extremist}}s.

== Skins ==
{{Item Skins|Final Destination Helmet}}

== Tips ==
* '''Final Destination Armor''' is often compared to {{Item|Burning Crimson Armor}}: while {{Item|Burning Crimson Armor}} is superior in terms of raw damage, '''Final Destination Armor''' is significantly better for survivability.
** If the player is able to survive a Tier II {{Mob|Voidgloom Seraph}}, then {{Item|Burning Crimson Armor}} is recommended.

== Trivia ==
* '''Final Destination Armor''' is a reference to the ''Final Destination'' franchise.
